sources.title: PhoWhisper-large: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview PhoWhisper-large is a Vietnamese automatic speech recognition model maintained by vinai. It fine-tunes OpenAI’s multilingual Whisper architecture for Vietnamese speech, using an 844-hour training dataset that covers diverse Vietnamese accents.
